core_contribution.summary: Add validated task goal/contribution bindings and a durable lifecycle scoreboard so selection, transition, and closure remain tied to the presentable full-portfolio deliverable.

acceptance_checks_passed: GOAL-CORE-PRESENTABLE-PORTFOLIO remains active until complete mission closure.
Every remaining task binds one or more subordinate goals and one visible-output, blocker-removal, safety, or acceptance-proof contribution.
Status reports dynamic denominator and every required local lifecycle count from durable repository state.
Closing a machinery task without its evidenced contribution or corresponding scoreboard/blocker delta fails closed.
Restart and graph migration preserve the same scoreboard and next eligible task.
